performance.verdict: No paid ads live 56 days in; overdue milestones are the real emergency.

findings.text: 5 milestones overdue by up to 25 days: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — all were due by 2026-08-01.
Zero paid spend across all 28 days ($0 Meta, $0 Google Ads); engagement SOW target of ~$6,500/mo is entirely undeployed with no launch date visible.
GBP is the only active channel: 90 actions in 28 days (+10.53% WoW), but last 2 days (Aug 23–24) show 0 actions — a 3-day zero streak worth watching.

Instagram reach fell -31.86% WoW; 3-day signal (Aug 22–24: 584, 772, 572) vs prior 3 (Aug 19–21: 811, 762, 295) is flat-to-mixed — no clear collapse, but 28-day peak of 4,307 on Aug 6 is not repeating.
GHL shows 371 contacts but only 1 opportunity created and 0 appointments in 28 days — intake pipeline is not converting contacts, though $0 paid spend means this is a setup issue, not an ads leak.

suggestions.text: Escalate LSA Verification and Pre-Launch Stack Test to Nacer immediately; both are confirmed blockers for any ad spend.
